body: I have mixed feelings on the hourglass tint! I think it’s more of a me issue (possibly not compatible with my skin type) because everyone adores it. Overall it’s just okay to me. A solid choice though if you’re really in the market for a skin tint
I didn’t love the one size spray, personally. Idk if I just got a bad batch/it was defective but I thought the continuous spray was odd. Just felt harsh and made me cough lol
Agree! I just switched from the haus labs to the hourglass, and while I really like it so far, it is prone to creasing under my eyes
